name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: A 5-skill modular marketplace that audits any public brand website for AI-engine readiness, covering crawlability, structured data, entity trust, and engagement signals.
author: brand-ai-readiness-audit contributors

skills.name: Audit Orchestrator
skills.description: Coordinates end-to-end audit execution across all domain sub-skills, deduplicates findings, injects proactive recommendations, and validates final output against report.schema.json.

skills.name: Crawl & Render Access
skills.description: Audits robots.txt AI bot policies, SSR vs CSR text blanking ratios, HTTP status codes, and sitemap completeness.

skills.name: Structured Fact Extraction
skills.description: Validates Schema.org JSON-LD markup, detects facts trapped in images/canvas/PDFs, and inspects freshness metadata.

skills.name: Trust & Entity Corroboration
skills.description: Validates sameAs entity graph linkage, NAP (Name/Address/Phone) consistency across pages, and brand disambiguation heuristics.

skills.name: Engagement & Retention
skills.description: Audits above-the-fold navigation and H1 orientation, detects post-load interstitials and modals, and measures viewport layout stability.
